description: This file defines a PHP class 'PartialEmployeeAttachment' in the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Pim\Dto'. The class models a data transfer object (DTO) for employee attachment details, including attachment ID, description, filename, size, file type, attached by info, and timestamps. It uses a trait for date/time formatting and provides getter methods for each property.

classes.name: PartialEmployeeAttachment
classes.description: A DTO class representing partial employee attachment information, including metadata and timestamps, with encapsulated getters and constructor.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize properties with attachment details and timestamp, setting attached date and time.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the attachment.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the file type of the attachment.

methods.name: getAttachedBy
methods.description: Returns the ID of the user who attached the file.

methods.name: getAttachedByName
methods.description: Returns the name of the user who attached the file.

methods.name: getAttachedTime
methods.description: Returns the attached time as a string.

methods.name: getAttachedDate
methods.description: Returns the attached date as a string.

methods.name: setAttachedTime
methods.description: Sets the attachedTime property formatted from a DateTime object.

methods.name: setAttachedDate
methods.description: Sets the attachedDate property formatted from a DateTime object.
